tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: Every live tool with its slug, purpose, category, price per call (USDC) and endpoint.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Input JSON Schema, output description, examples, limits and prices for one tool.

tools.name: run_tool
tools.description: Run a tool on an input matching its input schema (see get_tool). Pay with payment_signature (x402 v2) or a pass api_key. Without either, returns HTTP 402 with payment_required describing the USDC payment.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "run_tool" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
